summary: UHF RFID inlays are the core component inside every UHF tag and label — a chip bonded to an antenna on thin PET film. We supply wet inlays (with adhesive) and dry inlays (without adhesive) featuring Impinj Monza, NXP UCODE and other leading chipsets for label converters, tag manufacturers and system integrators.
